title: A non-invasive, automated diagnosis of Menière's disease using radiomics and machine learning on conventional magnetic resonance imaging: A multicentric, case-controlled feasibility study.
summary: Multicentre case-control radiomics study on conventional MRI with an MLP classifier diagnosing Meniere's disease (120 patients, 140 controls); a clinically specific retrospective diagnostic assessment with an identified ML role.
